sentences.text: iZombie -LRB- stylized as iZOMBiE -RRB- is an American television series developed by Rob Thomas and Diane Ruggiero-Wright for The CW .	Rob Thomas	Rob Thomas (writer)	Diane Ruggiero-Wright	Diane Ruggiero	The CW	The CW

It is a loose adaptation of the comic book series of the same name created by Chris Roberson and Michael Allred , and published by DC Comics under their Vertigo imprint .	Chris Roberson	Chris Roberson (author)	Michael Allred	Michael Allred	Vertigo	Vertigo (DC Comics)	comic book	comic book	of the same name	iZOMBIE	DC Comics	DC Comics	imprint	Imprint (trade name)
The series was renewed for a second season , which premiered October 6 , 2015 , and ran for 19 episodes .
On March 11 , 2016 , The CW renewed the series for a third season of 13 episodes , which premiered on April 4 , 2017 .	The CW	The CW
On May 10 , 2017 , The CW renewed the series for a fourth season .	The CW	The CW
